correctness.rationale: For Φ(X)=sX+(1−s)Tr(X)σ the unnormalized Choi matrix J=s|Ω〉〈Ω|+(1−s)I⊗σ. Partial transpose decomposes into diagonal sectors and 2×2 |ij〉,|ji〉 blocks with determinant (1−s)²p_i p_j−s², hence PPT iff s≤√(p_(1)p_(2))/(1+√(p_(1)p_(2))). To prove sufficiency (not generally implied by PPT), average 3^d explicit product projectors using independent cubic phases with weights p_i^(−1/4),√s p_j^(1/4), yielding s|Ω〉〈Ω|+sΣ_{i≠j}√(p_j/p_i)|ij〉〈ij|. The residual J−S is diagonal with coefficients (1−s)p_j−s√(p_j/p_i)≥0 under precisely that PPT condition; all d≥3 and endpoint s=0/equality work. Semigroup s=e^(−γt) and Lindblad operators √(γp_i)|i〉〈j| establish exact first EB time. Independent complex-tensor computations through d=4 checked this finite separable decomposition and PPT eigenvalue signs.

value.rationale: Exact EB horizons are operational invariants for quantum noise channels. The full-rank arbitrary-dimensional reset model has a simple but previously unchecked dependence on the *two smallest* target populations; the proof provides an explicit separable Choi certificate establishing when PPT is sufficient despite generally failing at d≥3, not merely a generic threshold guess.

limitations: Exact for identity–replacement interpolation and single-rate reset semigroup with faithful σ (at least three distinct eigenvalues), d≥3.
No arbitrary thermal Lindbladian, coherent Hamiltonian, or multirate result; finite numerics do not imply arbitrary d.
